channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay South Block 18A
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay South Block 18A (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 18A: The name ended in "(UCSF planned)", a status that can…
item.description: The name ended in "(UCSF planned)", a status that can change and belongs in the record's status, not in a permanent name or page address. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address now redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: No source change; the status is shown in the record's status field..

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 18A: Block 18A's 'planned' status now says what it rests on…
item.description: Block 18A's 'planned' status now says what it rests on: UCSF's land-use designation of the block as Research, not an approved or scheduled project. UCSF's June 2025 presentation lists it among 'Undeveloped parcels remaining' and says 'No building plans at Mission Bay right now'. Source: UCSF Mission Bay Planned Development, CAC presentation, June 12, 2025 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 18A: Block 18A's notes placed it west of the Owens St curve…
item.description: Block 18A's notes placed it west of the Owens St curve, north of Nelson Rising Lane, and back-to-back with the existing childcare building 18C. UCSF's map and our own map shape put it south of Nelson Rising Lane and east of the curve, with 18B between it and 18C. The parking-lot statement is now labelled an imagery observation, the equal-area split is described as our approximation, and the 2019 milestone now cites the December 2015 property management plan map. Source: UCSF Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf); OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, 2019-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf); USDA NAIP imagery, viewed 2026-09-29 (https://apps.geo.fpac.usda.gov/geo-imagery/rest/services/naip/conus_naip/ImageServer); OCII Mission Bay Long-Range Property Management Plan, Attachment B map, 2015-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf).
item.source: UCSF Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf); OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, 2019-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf); USDA NAIP imagery, viewed 2026-09-29 (https://apps.geo.fpac.usda.gov/geo-imagery/rest/services/naip/conus_naip/ImageServer); OCII Mission Bay Long-Range Property Management Plan, Attachment B map, 2015-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf)

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay South Block 18A: UCSF files a Notice of Determination to… (Jan 18, 2018)
item.description: UCSF files a Notice of Determination to install temporary electric-vehicle charging in about 30 shuttle parking spaces at the 'Block 18A temporary shuttle yard, until such time that the lot is developed with permanent uses' (Jan 18, 2018). Source: Regents of the University of California, via CEQAnet, 2018-01-18.
